{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Inspect the revenue column for format
print("First few values of revenue:")
print(df['revenue'].head())

# Check for thousands separators
print("\nUnique revenue values with non-numeric characters:")
non_numeric = df['revenue'].str.contains(r'[^0-9.,]', na=False)
print(df.loc[non_numeric, 'revenue'].unique())

# Confirm the format is like '1,234.56'
print("\nExample of revenue format:")
print(df['revenue'].iloc[0])"}
